whenToUse: Folder and file explorers for a code project, a workspace or a document store
Record hierarchies such as CRM accounts and contacts, or an org chart of who reports to whom
Role permission editors grouped by area, where each action is ticked on or off

whenNotToUse.when: A whole drive page with a folder rail beside a listing of the open folder
Folder rows with size and item count columns that move into other folders by pointer
A pick of one value from a nested list, made inside a popup

agentNotes: `syncDataLoaderFeature` throws when `getItem` returns nothing or a promise, so children fetched from a server need the async data loader feature
The `rootItemId` record is never drawn, so its children form the top level and its own name stays hidden
After adding, moving or removing records behind `dataLoader`, call rebuildTree on `tree`, or the rows keep the old structure
